title: Change set v2: close F1 of ART-20260906-034 (project-less issues) alongside the original bypass

findings.title: F1 of ART-20260906-034: project-less issues had no staffing gate on recordInboundMail
findings.detail: A resolved project of null (an issue parented directly under a client or engagement, which canParent permits) left evidence.add as the sole gate on both create and attach modes. ROLE_CLIENT_SPONSOR and ROLE_CLIENT_LEAD both hold evidence.add, so a client seat could reach any project-less issue in the tenant, not only their own client's.
findings.failureScenario: A client sponsor attaches fabricated mail evidence to a structural issue outside their own client's scope, with no project to check staffing against.

review.resolution: Both branches (create, keyed on body.parentId; attach, keyed on the resolved target) now require can(state.model, session.actor, 'internal.view') whenever projectOf returns null, mirroring the internal/client boundary the client-filter work (ART-20260905-023) already established. Scenario CD14 proves the two conditions the route depends on: projectOf returns null for a client-parented issue, and internal.view distinguishes a client-role actor (who still holds evidence.add) from an internal one. Verified directly: every other recordInboundMail construction site in the repository is the machine intake path (exempt by isMachineActor, unaffected) or a test/proof script, confirmed by grep across the full tree.
